textual.context: The title and description present the offer directly; whether this is promotional, informational, or otherwise is unclear from the supplied records.
textual.potential_relevance: A monetary gift-card reward claim is linked to a requested action/destination: viewers are told to 'Get Access here' at an external URL.
textual.limitations: No ASR or OCR is available. The records do not establish what the URL leads to, what conditions apply, whether any gift card is provided, or who operates the destination.

visual.observation: A webpage using Fandango branding displays the offer text “RECEIVE A $25 FANDANGO GIFT CARD” with “PARTICIPATION AND PURCHASES REQUIRED” and a “CLICK HERE FOR DETAILS” link, alongside an email entry field, consent checkbox, and orange “Continue” button.
visual.context: Context is unclear from the sampled frames; the page appears to present an offer form rather than a warning or report. Visible text includes brand-style Fandango header and movie imagery.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship crossing the threshold is a specific $25 gift-card reward claim linked to requested email submission/consent and a Continue action, with stated participation and purchase conditions.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish who operates the page, whether the branding is authorized, what happens after Continue, whether any purchase occurs, or whether the offer is fulfilled.

visual.observation: Lower-page offer details state that completing offers is required to receive the reward and show dense “SUMMARY OF PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS” terms, including age/residency eligibility and references to completing sponsor offers; the exact full terms are partly too small to read.
visual.context: The frames show the same Fandango gift-card offer page scrolled lower, with legal/terms-style text and links such as gift status/help/privacy/terms/contact visible near the bottom.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship crossing the threshold is that the advertised gift-card reward is conditioned on additional offer/program requirements rather than only ordinary page navigation.
visual.limitations: Most fine print is not fully legible in the sampled frames, and the frames do not show the complete offer flow, all required purchases, cancellation terms, or final eligibility determination.

visual.observation: A large arrow-shaped graphic on the left says “Get Access Link in Description” while the offer page is displayed.
visual.context: The arrow appears as an overlay or video graphic directing viewers outside the visible page area; the actual description link is not shown in the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship crossing the threshold is an instruction to use an external description link in connection with the visible gift-card offer and form flow.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show the actual description, URL, destination, or whether the link leads to the displayed page.

visual_context_notes.observation: The offer page visibly includes a qualification line “PARTICIPATION AND PURCHASES REQUIRED” near the main reward claim.

The email/consent area contains a checkbox statement indicating agreement to terms/privacy and consent to receive promotional emails or offers from listed partners, though much of the small text is hard to read.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a purported free $25 Fandango gift card and directs viewers to an external access link that requests an email, consent, and a Continue action. The lower-page terms indicate that additional sponsor offers and purchases must be completed, which conflicts with the uncomplicated “free” presentation and establishes a participation and purchase flow. The frames do not establish who operates the page, whether the branding is authorized, what follows the Continue action, or whether the reward is ultimately provided.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The free gift-card offer is linked to an external access instruction and a displayed claim flow requesting an email address; the page also states participation and purchase requirements.
